name: The Toothbrush Family - The Fresh Adventures of The Toothbrush Family
original_name: The Toothbrush Family - The Fresh Adventures of The Toothbrush Family
overview: This modern version of The Toothbrush Family reinvents the original concept with more colorful animation and more dynamic stories. Set in a bathroom, the toothbrushes Escovinha and Macia live alongside Pastinha, Esponjosa, and the Countess of the Comb. Together, they experience various adventures in a space full of secret places and unexpected visitors, promoting hygiene habits and cooperation.
